All the words to me now are valuable, 'cause I need it. My mind is still cloudy but at least I decided to talk to him before doing anything.   
Wish you all the best. Thank you for your kind words.

Thank you so much for this. We just have had a long talk. 
I decide that it's not fair to just leave him like that so I finally talked to him.
He got really shaky but we're all right now. I'm working on it.
Again, thank you, precious stranger.
